identity.name: E1
identity.mission: Create a bold, cinematic, luxury salon experience that breaks generic templates.
principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix luxury fashion aesthetics with functional salon utility.
Emotion First: Every interaction must feel 'expensive' and 'smooth'.
Content is King: The imagery and typography tell the story.
Zoom In: Use macro shots of scissors, hair textures, and products.
Negative Space: Dark mode requires breathing room. Use it.

color_usage.interactive: Electric Blue (#3B82F6) for primary buttons and hover states to cut through the dark/gold theme.
color_usage.borders: Subtle Gold (#D4AF37) at 20% opacity for cards and dividers.

headings.usage: Use for all Section Titles, Hero Headings, and Service Names.
headings.style: Italicize key words for emphasis. Use tracking-tight.

body.usage: Use for all descriptions, pricing, and reviews.

layout.spacing: Generous. Use p-12 to p-24 for section padding.

hero_shutter.description: A cinematic reveal animation that runs once on page load.
hero_shutter.structure: Two fixed div panels (left and right) covering the screen.
hero_shutter.content_reveal: Hero text scales up (0.9 -> 1) and fades in (0 -> 1) as shutters open.

buttons.primary: bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-500 text-white rounded-full px-8 py-6 text-lg font-medium transition-all duration-300 shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(59,130,246,0.3)] hover:shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(59,130,246,0.5)]
buttons.secondary: border border-gold/30 text-gold hover:bg-gold/10 rounded-full px-8 py-6 transition-all duration-300

cards.style: bg-white/5 backdrop-blur-sm border border-white/10 hover:border-gold/30 transition-colors duration-300 rounded-xl overflow-hidden

pricing_list.style: Minimalist list with dotted leaders or wide spacing. Price in Gold, Service Name in White.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. IMPLEMENTATION: Use React (JS) + Tailwind + Framer Motion.
2. SHUTTER ANIMATION: This is the MVP feature. It must work smoothly. Use 'framer-motion' for the panels.
3. SCROLL REVEALS: All sections must fade in and slide up as the user scrolls. Use 'whileInView' prop from Framer Motion.
4. TYPOGRAPHY: Enforce 'Playfair Display' for all headings. It gives the luxury feel.
5. MICRO-INTERACTIONS: Buttons must glow on hover. Images must zoom slightly on hover.
6. NO TEMPLATES: Do not use standard Shadcn cards. Build custom layouts using the 'cards.style' defined above.
7. WHATSAPP: Keep the existing WhatsApp float button but ensure it sits above the footer.
8. BOOKING: The 'Book Now' button should link to 'https://dikidi.app'.
9. MAP: Embed a Google Map for the location '114 Vilankuruchi Road, Coimbatore'.
10. FOOTER: Make it large (py-20) with a gold logo and clear navigation.
universal_guidelines: Do not use gradients for backgrounds, use solid dark colors with noise/grain overlays.
Ensure text contrast is high (Gold on Black is tricky, use lighter Gold #F7E7CE for small text).
Use 'lucide-react' for icons (Scissors, MapPin, Phone, Star).
Keep the DOM clean. Avoid unnecessary wrappers.
